In Revelation 2:17, twice, Christ promises the one who overcomes 'a white stone, and on the stone a new name written'—possibly an image of acquittal, admission to the messianic banquet, or a token of intimate knowledge. The white pebble may echo jury votes, where white meant acquittal and black condemnation."
